evidence.quote: Summary: We present some open problems and some conjectures about some interesting types of nonlinear difference equations of order greater than one.

trace.notes: Normalized the user URL https://zbmath.org/970434 to the canonical zbMATH record https://zbmath.org/0860.39018.

The resolved source is a bibliographic/review page. It exposes the title, venue metadata, a short summary, and a Review PDF link, but not a readable full-text copy of the 1995 conference article itself.

Failed the source adequacy gate because the available source text is citation/review metadata rather than the article body containing the actual open problems. Exact-title web searches did not recover a readable exact-work copy of the same article, so no grounded extraction was accepted.
